# Pranjal Garg

Pranjal Garg studies learning, neural dynamics, and computation in biological and artificial systems.

## Selected published research
- [Generalized contrastive PCA](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1012747): A hyperparameter-free method for identifying patterns that differ between high-dimensional datasets, published in PLOS Computational Biology in 2025.
- [DiI staining of sensory neurons in Steinernema hermaphroditum](https://doi.org/10.17912/micropub.biology.000516): A fluorescence-staining protocol for identifying sensory neurons in an entomopathogenic nematode, published in microPublication Biology in 2022.
- [Modeling Neural Dynamics Using Periodic Structured State-Space Models](https://neurips.cc/virtual/2024/109052): A periodic state-space approach to hippocampal population dynamics, presented at the NeurIPS 2024 WiML Workshop.
- [Exploring popular culture and perceptions of STEMM careers](https://escholarship.org/uc/item/05m8h9t1): A path-analysis study published in the Proceedings of the Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society in 2023.
- [Awareness of the malaria vaccine in India](https://doi.org/10.7759/cureus.29210): A survey study published in Cureus in 2022.
- [Complete writing and citation list](https://neurogarg.github.io/writings.html): Papers, preprints, proceedings, perspectives, and technical writing with BibTeX.

## Research projects
- [Spontaneous Context Restoration](https://neurogarg.github.io/ai.html#spontaneous-context-restoration): How language models recover from corrupted inputs, and whether intermediate representations predict recovery.
- [MetaLex: metaphors across vision and language](https://neurogarg.github.io/ai.html#metalex): A benchmark testing whether vision-language models recover the same figurative meanings from matched images and text.
- [Active vision in Drosophila](https://neurogarg.github.io/neuroscience.html#active-vision): How retinal movements and neural activity relate to an animal’s sensory input.
- [Co-adaptive biological–artificial intelligence](https://neurogarg.github.io/ai.html#co-adaptive-intelligence): How heterogeneous learners specialize and share information under a common objective.
